ui_bugs.component: TrainingMode first switch to Model Vessel
ui_bugs.issue: On a device with no mbp_model_copy:<uid> in localStorage (first time, or after a fresh Model Vessel copy), picking Help > Model Vessel > Question Demo from another boat and pressing 'Switch and start' opens the Basic Introduction walkthrough instead. RCA: switchToModel calls restartWalkthrough(uid, 'question demo') then TrainingMode mounts and the copy check `useState(() => { if (copy && read(k.copy) !== copy) reset(k) })` calls reset(k) with default which=BASIC, overwriting the chosen wizard. Fix: keep read(k.which) (or pass it) in that reset when a restart was just requested.
